name: The Grind
controllingIdea: Behind every success is the unseen daily effort that makes it possible.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A glimpse into actual daily work - the behind-the-scenes
narrativeArc.risingAction: The unsexy but necessary tasks and routines
narrativeArc.crisis: The challenge of consistency - why most people don't see this
narrativeArc.climax: Why it's worth it - the connection to client outcomes
narrativeArc.resolution: Appreciation earned, invitation to understand the work

triggerMoments.moment: Early morning or late night work

questions.question: What does your actual daily work look like? The unglamorous parts?
questions.placeholder: 4am wake up for a 6am inspection, then showings until 8pm...

questions.question: What tasks do most people not realize agents do?
questions.placeholder: Endless paperwork, coordinating 10 different parties, solving problems at midnight...

questions.question: What's the hardest part about maintaining this pace?
questions.placeholder: Missing family dinners, never fully off, the mental load...

questions.question: Why is it worth it? What keeps you going?
questions.placeholder: Because when I hand over those keys, every missed dinner was worth it...

questions.question: What do you want people to understand about the work?
questions.placeholder: This isn't 9-5. It's a lifestyle. And I wouldn't have it any other way...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is an authenticity and dedication piece. Show the real work behind the results. Not complaining - celebrating the hustle and connecting it to client value.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Real, not whiny. Proud of the work ethic without martyrdom. Connect the grind to client outcomes. Show, don't just tell.

usageHints: Connect the work to client outcomes
Best when feeling energized, not exhausted

exampleScenarios.title: The 14-Hour Day
exampleScenarios.situation: Showing what a full day actually looks like
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Today: 6am inspection, 8am contract negotiations, 10am listing photos, noon client lunch, 2pm showings, 5pm open house prep, 7pm buyer presentation. I'll answer emails at midnight. This is the job. I love it.

expectedOutput.hook: 6am to midnight. This is what the job really looks like.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Every hour is an hour closer to someone's keys.
